name: Scout
role: The narrator: a tomboy, almost six when the story begins
hint1: She would rather wear overalls than a dress.
hint2: She fights boys who insult her father.
hint3: On Halloween she is dressed as a ham.
hint4: She tells the whole story.

name: Jem
role: Scout's older brother, nearly ten when the story begins
hint1: He reads to a sick old lady every afternoon for a month.
hint2: He goes back alone at night for his lost trousers.
hint3: He cries after the verdict.
hint4: He is the older of the two Finch children.

name: Atticus Finch
role: Scout and Jem's father, a lawyer who defends Tom Robinson
hint1: He is nearly fifty and wears glasses.
hint2: He kills a mad dog with a single shot.
hint3: He sits outside the jail one night with a lamp and a newspaper.
hint4: He is Scout and Jem's dad.

name: Calpurnia
role: The Finches' Black cook, who helps to bring up Scout and Jem
hint1: She speaks one way at work and another way with her own people.
hint2: She has been with the family since Jem was born.
hint3: She takes the children to First Purchase one Sunday.
hint4: She runs the Finches' house and is strict with Scout.

name: Aunt Alexandra
role: Atticus's sister, who moves in to make a lady of Scout
hint1: She cares a great deal about where people come from.
hint2: She wants Scout to wear dresses and be more polite.
hint3: She holds the missionary circle tea at the Finches' house.
hint4: Francis is her grandson, and she moves in with the Finches.

name: Uncle Jack
role: Atticus's younger brother, a doctor who visits at Christmas
hint1: He has a cat called Rose Aylmer.
hint2: He takes a splinter out of Scout's foot.
hint3: He punishes Scout without hearing her side, then says sorry.
hint4: He studied medicine in Boston and visits the Finches every winter.

name: Francis
role: Scout's cousin, Aunt Alexandra's grandson
hint1: He tells tales to get Scout into trouble.
hint2: He insults Atticus to make Scout angry.
hint3: Scout hits him and splits her knuckle on his teeth.
hint4: He is Scout's spiteful relative at Finch's Landing.

name: Simon Finch
role: The ancestor who founded Finch's Landing
hint1: He trapped animals for their fur and sold medicines.
hint2: He crossed the Atlantic to escape attacks on Methodists.
hint3: He built a homestead on the banks of the Alabama River.
hint4: Atticus, Jack and Alexandra are all descended from him.

name: Dill
role: Scout and Jem's summer friend, who stays with his aunt next door
hint1: He tells wild stories about his father.
hint2: He is small for his age, with very fair hair.
hint3: He cries in court at the way Tom is spoken to.
hint4: He runs away from home and hides under Scout's bed.

name: Boo Radley
role: The mysterious neighbour who never comes out
hint1: Children say he eats raw squirrels and cats.
hint2: He puts a blanket around Scout's shoulders during the fire.
hint3: He leaves little presents in a knot-hole.
hint4: He saves Jem and Scout from Bob Ewell.

name: Nathan Radley
role: Boo's older brother, who fills the knot-hole with cement
hint1: He takes over the family house when his father dies.
hint2: One night he fires a shotgun at a noise in his collard patch.
hint3: He tells Jem a lie about why the hole had to be filled.
hint4: He blocks the knot-hole so that no more presents can be left.

name: Miss Maudie
role: A widow who loves her garden and is a friend to the children
hint1: Some strict Baptists say her love of nature is a sin.
hint2: She explains why it is a sin to kill a mockingbird.
hint3: She stays cheerful after her house burns down.
hint4: She lives across the street from the Finches and grows azaleas.

name: Mrs Dubose
role: A bad-tempered old neighbour fighting a morphine addiction
hint1: She has a maid called Jessie.
hint2: People say she hides a pistol under her shawls.
hint3: She shouts insults at the Finch children from her porch.
hint4: Atticus calls her the bravest person he ever knew.

name: Miss Stephanie
role: The street's gossip
hint1: She claims she once woke to find Boo looking in her window.
hint2: She tells everyone about Boo and the scissors.
hint3: She spreads the word that Bob Ewell spat at Atticus.
hint4: Whatever happens on the street, she tells the whole town.

name: Tim Johnson
role: A dog with rabies that Atticus shoots
hint1: His owner drives the bus to Mobile.
hint2: Calpurnia telephones the whole street to warn them about him.
hint3: He walks down the street in a strange, crooked way.
hint4: Atticus kills him with one bullet.

name: Bob Ewell
role: Mayella's father, who accuses Tom Robinson and later attacks the children
hint1: He is named after a famous Confederate general.
hint2: He writes with his left hand.
hint3: He spits in Atticus's face.
hint4: He attacks Jem and Scout in the dark and is killed.

name: Mayella Ewell
role: Bob Ewell's eldest daughter, who accuses Tom Robinson
hint1: She grows red geraniums in old jars outside her home.
hint2: She does not seem to know what a friend is.
hint3: She asks a neighbour to break up an old chiffarobe for her.
hint4: She is the young woman at the centre of the trial.

name: Burris Ewell
role: Bob Ewell's son, who comes to school only on the first day
hint1: He hasn't had a bath for a very long time.
hint2: He makes Miss Caroline cry.
hint3: A cootie crawls out of his hair in class.
hint4: He is a boy from the family by the dump who comes to class once a year.

name: Tom Robinson
role: A Black man accused of raping Mayella Ewell, whom Atticus defends
hint1: He works in Link Deas's cotton fields.
hint2: He says he felt sorry for a white woman, and the courtroom turns against him.
hint3: He can't use his left hand since an accident with a cotton gin.
hint4: Atticus defends him in court.

name: Helen Robinson
role: Tom Robinson's wife
hint1: Her church takes up a collection for her.
hint2: She falls down when she hears terrible news.
hint3: Link Deas gives her work when no one else will.
hint4: She is married to the man Atticus defends.

name: Reverend Sykes
role: The minister of First Purchase church
hint1: He won't let anyone go home until enough money is raised for Helen.
hint2: He takes Jem, Scout and Dill to sit with him at the trial.
hint3: He fears the jury will never take a Black man's word over a white man's.
hint4: He tells Scout to stand up as her father passes.

name: Heck Tate
role: Maycomb County's sheriff
hint1: He is the first witness at the trial.
hint2: He hands Atticus a rifle when a sick animal comes down the street.
hint3: He says that Bob Ewell fell on his own blade.
hint4: He is the county's top law officer.

name: Judge Taylor
role: The judge at Tom Robinson's trial
hint1: He looks half asleep but misses nothing.
hint2: Someone tries to break into his house one Sunday night.
hint3: He chose Atticus to defend Tom.
hint4: He bangs his gavel to keep order when Tom is tried.

name: Mr Gilmer
role: The prosecutor at Tom Robinson's trial
hint1: He questions Mayella and her father gently.
hint2: He keeps calling a grown man 'boy'.
hint3: His cruel questions make Dill cry.
hint4: He argues against Atticus in court.

name: Mr Underwood
role: The owner and editor of The Maycomb Tribune
hint1: He says he despises Black people, yet he protects Atticus.
hint2: One night he watches over Atticus from a window, armed.
hint3: He writes that Tom's death was like the killing of songbirds.
hint4: He runs The Maycomb Tribune.

name: Dolphus Raymond
role: A rich white man who lives among the Black community and pretends to be drunk
hint1: He owns land by the river and comes from an old family.
hint2: He lives with the Black people of Maycomb and has mixed-race children.
hint3: He offers Dill a drink to settle his stomach.
hint4: His paper sack holds a soft drink, not alcohol.

name: Link Deas
role: Tom Robinson's employer, who speaks up for him
hint1: He visits the Finch house with other men before the trial.
hint2: He is thrown out of court for interrupting.
hint3: He frightens Bob Ewell away from a woman who works for him.
hint4: He gives jobs to the accused man and, later, to his wife.

name: Mr Cunningham
role: A poor but proud farmer from Old Sarum
hint1: He pays his bills with firewood, nuts and vegetables.
hint2: He has trouble with an entailment.
hint3: A little girl's chat makes him change his mind outside the jail.
hint4: His son has no lunch on Scout's first day at school.

name: Mrs Merriweather
role: A churchgoing lady who leads the missionary circle and writes the Halloween pageant
hint1: She is said to be the most devout lady in Maycomb.
hint2: She feels sorry for a tribe far away in Africa.
hint3: She complains that her Black maid has been sulky since the trial.
hint4: She writes the show in which Scout plays a ham.

name: Walter Cunningham
role: Scout's classmate, the son of a poor farmer
hint1: He has hookworms from going barefoot.
hint2: He refuses to take a quarter from the teacher.
hint3: At the Finches' table he drowns his meat and vegetables in something sweet and sticky.
hint4: Scout rubs his nose in the dirt on her first day.

name: Miss Caroline
role: Scout's first-grade teacher, new to Maycomb
hint1: She comes from Winston County in north Alabama.
hint2: She has never heard of the Cunninghams.
hint3: A cootie crawling out of a boy's hair frightens her.
hint4: She is the new young woman in charge of Scout's class.

name: Miss Gates
role: Scout's third-grade teacher
hint1: Scout overhears her talking on the courthouse steps.
hint2: She runs a Current Events lesson.
hint3: She says persecution is wrong, but not when it happens at home.
hint4: She tells Scout's class what is happening in Germany.

name: Cecil Jacobs
role: A classmate who teases Scout about Atticus
hint1: He lives at the far end of the street, next to the post office.
hint2: He walks a long way round to avoid passing the Radley Place.
hint3: He tells everyone that Scout's father defends Black people.
hint4: He jumps out and frightens Jem and Scout on their way to the pageant.
